_about: Who proposed each mining batch, as far as a record or the documented procedure shows. tools/query/export_rdf.py reads this to write one sw:Proposal per batch. A reference's batch is the one its crossvendor_checked string names. Damian ruled on 2026-11-06 that the documented procedure counts as a source, labelled as such; a batch the procedure attribution would misdescribe is excluded, and a reference whose audit names no batch gets no Proposal stage. Nothing here is inferred.

procedure.document: pipeline/README.md, the invariant line, in the file since commit c6409d4d (2026-07-26)
procedure.covers: every b- batch not listed under records or excluded

excluded.b-cw11-8: The batch note says the firing ran steps 1 to 3, mining included, in a claude-haiku-5-5 session, and does not say which model the miner subagent ran on. The procedure attribution could be false here, so the batch has no Proposal stage.
